mapper.insert: INSERT INTO restaurant_info (destination_id, main_menu, price_range, opening_hours, break_time, closed_days, parking_available, pet_allowed, seat_count, takeout_available, delivery_available, reservation, contact_number, homepage_url, etc) VALUES (#{destinationId}, #{mainMenu}, #{priceRange}, #{openingHours}, #{breakTime}, #{closedDays}, #{parkingAvailable}, #{petAllowed}, #{seatCount}, #{takeoutAvailable}, #{deliveryAvailable}, #{reservation}, #{contactNumber}, #{homepageUrl}, #{etc})
mapper.select: SELECT id, destination_id, language_code, main_menu, price_range, opening_hours, break_time, closed_days, etc FROM restaurant_info_translations WHERE destination_id = #{destinationId} ORDER BY language_code ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO restaurant_info_translations (destination_id, language_code, main_menu, price_range, opening_hours, break_time, closed_days, etc) VALUES (#{destinationId}, #{languageCode}, #{mainMenu}, #{priceRange}, #{openingHours}, #{breakTime}, #{closedDays}, #{etc})
